subject: how to distribute facets in different pages

messages.author: 4c8481384f2d3218
messages.subject: how to distribute facets in different pages
parts:
Hi people,

I have a big data.frame from which I would like to plot some facets,
but when I do it, it creates too many plots and it is impossible to
distinguish many details, because they are too small.

Is there any way to distribute multiple facets in different pages with
ggplot2?

For example, in ggplot2's tutorial, in setion 7.2, you suggest to use
only a subset of the mpg dataset because otherwise it would take too
much space. How would you create the plots for the full mpg set?

I am relatively new to R so I wasn't able to solve the problem myself:
if I understand correctly, you can use the par() function to create
different plots with the standard plotting system, but this won't work
with ggplot2. The only solution I could think of is to split the data
in smaller datasets, but maybe there is a better way to do it..

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: how to distribute facets in different pages
parts:
I think your only option is to create subsets of the data that fit in one page,

library(ggplot2)

condition <- with(mpg, cyl != 5 & drv %in% c("4", "f") )

mpg1 <- mpg[condition, ]
mpg2 <- mpg[! condition, ]

p = qplot(cty, hwy, data = mpg) + facet_grid(drv ~ cyl)
p1 = p %+% mpg1
p2 = p %+% mpg2

# interactive
p1
dev.new()
p2

# non interactive
pdf()
print(p1)
print(p2)
dev.off()


HTH,

baptiste
